description: 📌 Stay in a spacious 165 m² duplex apartment in the heart of Paris's 10th arrondissement, which can accommodate up to 10 people. With its two spacious floors, it is ideal for families or groups of friends looking for comfort and conviviality. Located a few steps from République, the Canal Saint-Martin and the Marais, the flat enjoys an exceptional, lively and convenient location, perfectly served by several metro lines. A spacious and elegant pied-à-terre from which to discover Paris in completThe space🌟 A Spacious Modern Duplex in the Heart of Paris 10thIdeally located on the ground floor of a Parisian building, this large 165 m² duplex can comfortably accommodate up to 10 guests. Designed to combine space, modern comfort, and conviviality, it’s the perfect place for families, groups of friends, or travelers wishing to fully enjoy the capital.On the ground floor, you’ll find a spacious modern living room with a sofa bed, TV, and large dining table – ideal for relaxing or sharing meals. The fully equipped kitchen (coffee machine, kettle, toaster, microwave, oven…) has everything you need to cook just like at home. This level also includes a comfortable bedroom with a queen-size bed.Upstairs, three bright bedrooms with queen-size beds ensure restful nights. You’ll also find three bathrooms (two with WC), plus a separate toilet for added convenience. A washing machine is available to make your stay hassle-free.📍 A lively and central neighborhoodLocated in the 10th arrondissement, between République and Canal Saint-Martin, you’ll enjoy a dynamic and authentic atmosphere surrounded by cafés, restaurants, artisan bakeries, and trendy boutiques. With public transport just steps away, you can easily reach Paris’ must-sees: Le Marais, Montmartre, the Louvre, Notre-Dame, and eve
